description: This file defines the Csv class, a specialized reader within the PhpSpreadsheet library for reading CSV files. It handles file opening, encoding detection, delimiter inference, BOM skipping, and converts CSV data into a Spreadsheet object, supporting optional configurations like delimiter, enclosure, encoding, and line ending autodetection.

classes.name: Csv
classes.description: A class for reading CSV files into PhpSpreadsheet objects with configurable settings including delimiter, encoding, BOM handling, line ending autodetection, and data processing options.

methods.name: setConstructorCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback function to customize Csv reader defaults during construction.

methods.name: getConstructorCallback
methods.description: Retrieves the currently set constructor callback function.

methods.name: setInputEncoding
methods.description: Sets the character encoding expected in input CSV file.

methods.name: getInputEncoding
methods.description: Gets the current input encoding setting.

methods.name: setFallbackEncoding
methods.description: Sets the fallback encoding used if encoding detection fails.

methods.name: getFallbackEncoding
methods.description: Gets the current fallback encoding setting.

methods.name: skipBOM
methods.description: Skips the BOM marker in the CSV file if present to start reading at actual CSV data.

methods.name: checkSeparator
methods.description: Checks if the first line explicitly sets the separator using 'sep=' syntax.

methods.name: inferSeparator
methods.description: Infers the CSV delimiter by analyzing the content if not explicitly set.

methods.name: listWorksheetInfo
methods.description: Returns metadata about worksheet(s) within a CSV file structure.

methods.name: loadSpreadsheetFromFile
methods.description: Loads a CSV file into a new Spreadsheet object.

methods.name: loadSpreadsheetFromString

methods.name: openFileOrMemory
methods.description: Opens a CSV file or reads from memory, handling encoding and BOMs.

methods.name: setTestAutoDetect
methods.description: Enables or disables autodetection of line endings.

methods.name: setAutoDetect
methods.description: Sets auto_detect_line_endings PHP ini directive based on current test auto detect setting.

methods.name: castFormattedNumberToNumeric
methods.description: Configures whether formatted number strings are converted to numeric types.

methods.name: openDataUri
methods.description: Opens a data URI stream for reading CSV data.

methods.name: loadIntoExisting
methods.description: Loads CSV data into an existing Spreadsheet object.

methods.name: loadStringOrFile
methods.description: Handles loading CSV from filename or string, managing auto-detect settings.

methods.name: loadStringOrFile2
methods.description: Main implementation for loading CSV data into a Spreadsheet, processing rows and cells.

methods.name: convertBoolean
methods.description: Converts CSV string values 'true'/'false' to boolean types, or null.

methods.name: convertFormattedNumber
methods.description: Converts numeric strings to float or integer values, applying number formats when configured.

methods.name: getDelimiter

methods.name: setDelimiter

methods.name: guessEncodingTestBom
